description: This file defines an interface IAppLogger<T> which abstracts logging functionality, allowing code to depend on a custom logging interface rather than directly on ASP.NET Core logging types.

classes.name: IAppLogger<T>
classes.description: A generic interface for logging, designed to avoid direct dependency on ASP.NET Core logging types. Provides methods for logging information and warning messages.

methods.name: LogInformation
methods.description: Logs an informational message with optional parameters.

methods.name: LogWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional parameters.
